decisive_items: two great vessels arising in parallel from the right ventricle
severe tricuspid regurgitation and bidirectional shunting at both septal defects
response.rationale: R7 uniquely integrates the parallel great vessels from the right ventricle, bidirectional shunting at both septal defects, and right-sided dilation with left ventricular hypoplasia, matching the full constellation of Tetralogy of Fallot. R3 only captures the double-outlet right ventricle, missing the septal defects and tricuspid regurgitation.

rejected.why: Only covers tricuspid regurgitation and right heart dilation, missing the septal defects and great vessel origin.
Only covers tricuspid regurgitation, insufficient for the complex defect pattern.
Tricuspid atresia is contradicted by severe tricuspid regurgitation and lacks the double-outlet right ventricle.
Only covers the ventricular septal defect, missing the other components.
Only covers the atrial septal defect, missing the other components.
